stations.title: Cool loaves by dwell
stations.does: Loaves cool after coming from the oven while moving through the line before slicing.
steps: Receive hot loaves from upstream and register each loaf on the line reference
Index loaves onto an accumulation/dwell segment sized to hold the required cooling time within the takt
Maintain hygienic airflow/drape coverage over the loaves during the dwell segment
Release each loaf when its cooling dwell time is met and advance to the slicer

stations.title: Slice loaves to sandwiches
stations.does: Slice each loaf into sandwich slices.
steps: Clamp loaf at the slicer in-feed position using hygienic food-grade clamps
Execute slicing cycle at the preset slice thickness/count
Release clamps and allow slices to drop onto the downstream bagging-ready conveyor surface
Position the next loaf and repeat

stations.title: Bag sliced loaf
stations.does: Place the sliced loaf into a plastic bag.
steps: Pick/place bag open (bag mouth presented above the receiving zone)
Guide sliced loaf into the opened plastic bag without manual contact
Tamp/settle loaf inside the bag to achieve consistent packing height
Index the bagged loaf to the bag closing station

stations.title: Clip close bag
stations.does: Close the plastic bag using a clip.
steps: Bring bag mouth to a fixed clip position using a guide sleeve/air assist
Form the bag mouth gathering position (mouth aligned and tensioned)
Drive the clip onto the bag mouth until fully seated
Verify clip seated position with a simple presence/position sensor
Advance to labeling

stations.title: Apply date label
stations.does: Apply a date label onto the closed bag.
steps: Orient the bag on the belt so the label target zone faces up
Print/dispense date label text for the current production date
Tamp the label onto the bag surface with a fixed dwell to ensure adhesion
Hold for the configured label set time (within the station budget) then release bag

stations.title: Weigh check and accept/reject
stations.does: Weigh each bag using a check weigher and decide PASS/REJECT based on minimum weight.
steps: Place each labeled bag onto the check weigher platform
Record weight while the bag is held in a stable position
If weight >= minimum threshold: mark/route as ACCEPT
If weight < minimum threshold: mark/route as REJECT
Actuate a divert gate to send rejects to the reject bin/chute

stations.title: Pack accepted bags into crates
stations.does: Place accepted (packed) loaves into crates for shipment.
steps: Receive only ACCEPT bags (rejects have already been diverted)
Accumulate a crate at the packing position and keep crate orientation fixed
Pick accepted bag and place into crate at the next free location
If crate is full: move to discharge/queue for downstream shipping (no rework specified)

notes: Takt is 3.0 s/unit (1200 units/hour). Stations are budgeted to stay within 3.0 s, but the slicing and bagging operations typically require careful mechanical design to truly sustain 1200/h.

Cooling is implemented as a dwell/accumulation segment sized to meet the required cooling time without exceeding the 3 s takt; if real cooling needs longer residence time than 2.5 s, ST1 must be lengthened or the line rate must be reduced.
Reject handling is modeled as a pure diversion to a dedicated reject bin/chute with no rework, consistent with the brief.
Crates are treated as 'cases' for packaging flow; exact crate size and max per crate are not specified and will affect ST7 capacity and timing.
